Proper operation of this game is absolutely dependent on proper adjustment of the +5vdc power supply.
Before attempting to operate or troubleshoot this game, measure and adjust, as necessary, the +5vdc power supply voltage.
Measure voltage with meter leads contacting +5vde and ground traces on P.C.B., near the 6 pin connector.
The power supply voltage is set at the factory, but shocks due to shipping and handling may cause this setting to vary.
Sound volume is adjustable using the pot on the P.C.B. nearest the 22 pin connector.
Game time (length of game) is adjustable using the pot on the P.C.B. nearest the 6 pin connector.
